resources.string: Optional and off by default. You can use every feature without sharing usage analytics.
Sharing is unavailable in this build. No usage analytics will be sent.
Coarse onboarding steps, permission choices, and purchase or restore outcomes; app version, build number and Android platform; and a random identifier created when you agree.
Location history, coordinates, journal text, support logs, device model and advertising identifiers are excluded. Earlier actions are never replayed after you agree.
Whereday receives these events through Cloudflare. As with other internet connections, the service handling a request can see connection metadata such as your IP address.
Turning sharing off cancels delivery and removes queued events and the local identifier. It cannot recall events already received. Agreeing again creates a new identifier.
Your sharing preference could not be read or saved. Sharing is stopped for this session. Reset sharing before trying again; an earlier saved preference may remain until reset succeeds.
Background delivery could not be updated. Open Whereday again to retry.
Sharing is off. Queued events and the local identifier have been removed.
Allow Whereday to collect and send the usage events described on this screen from now on? You can turn this off at any time in Settings → Usage analytics.
